findings.evidence: TauCeti’s existing public declarations include `dividedPower_two_rep_serreRootGenerator_apply` and `dividedPower_two_rep_serreRootGenerator_apply_mem_lattice`; this file itself names the corresponding definitions `f4IntegralDividedAdjointSquare` and `f4ModularDividedAdjointSquare`. The naming guide requires standard terminology and consistency with adjacent declarations.
findings.fix: Rename all three using `dividedPower_two_ad` (or the adjacent API’s full `DividedAdjointSquare` terminology) and update their uses.
findings.issue: `f4_dividedAd_sq_rootVector_opposite`, `f4_dividedAd_sq_rootVector_eq_zero_of_short` (line 69), and `f4_dividedAd_sq_coroot_eq_zero` (line 144) abbreviate the operation as `dividedAd_sq`, unlike the established `dividedPower_two_…` terminology.

summary: Three public theorem names use nonstandard and locally inconsistent terminology for the second divided power of the adjoint map.
